original_requirement: Read exactly two byte flags for a transfer interlock. First read both bytes, then reject invalid first or second flags (values over 1) in that order as FLAG_A or FLAG_B. Require exactly one flag to be set; reject equal flags as INTERLOCK at the first byte. Return the sum as UInt16BE, and check trailing data after all constraints.
